About Sungrow Energy Storage System

In 2006, Sungrow ventured into the energy storage system (ESS) industry. Relying on its cutting-edge clean power conversion technology, 
industry-leading battery technologyand grid forming technology, Sungrow focuses on integrated energy storage systemsolutions. 
The core components of these systems include PCS, lithium-ion batteries and energy management systems. 
These “turnkey” ESS solutions can be designed to meet the demanding requirements for residential, C&I and utility-side applications alike,
committed to making the power interconnected reliably.

 What Makes an ACE 007 ESS?
0 Waste by Modular Design
0 Outage by Built-in ATS             
7 Ups by Full-stream Optimization
0 waste: 2-8h coverage, store every watt.

The 12.5kWh modular design enables flexible systems, covering peak and nighttime operation and serving applications from small shops to large factories.

0 outage: 10ms seamless switching, support off-grid operation.

The hybrid inverter features a built-in ATS, which achieves seamless switching within 10ms for uninterrupted factory operation.

7 Ups

Level up from installation, deployment, commissioning, operation, maintenance to profit and safety with full-stream optimization.

Install in a Coffee Break 
with the 50kWh Pre-built Stack




The 50kWh pre-built stack enables rapid forklift-ready deployment, while individual 90kg packs support manual handling and modular expansion or replacement.

Fit even in Corners
Maximizing Every Centimeter



The top heat dissipation design enables side intake and top exhaust, allowing seamless back-to-back stacking. Supports multiple layouts to fit tight spaces and maximize usable area.

3-step Setup
5-minute Power Up



With iSolarCloud, complete a PV+ESS plant setup in just 3 steps and start revenue within 5 minutes of commissioning without cross-vendor compatibility issues.

Operate in Water 
Up to 50cm Depth



With IP66 protection and fully sealed modules, it operates reliably even in 50cm of water. Without inspection or part replacement under harsh conditions for truly maintenance-free performance. 

Combine Old and New 
Batteries, Scale at Will



Featuring pack-level balancing technology, the system achieves full system energy balance within 48 hours, eliminating on-site manual calibration and avoiding full battery replacements.

AI-driven Modes
Capture Every Cent


The built-in En-grow self-learning algorithm to generate optimal energy dispatch strategies, supporting multiple business modes for revenue growth.

5D Alerts: 
Triple-guard Protection
Cell-to-plant Security





Triple Guard Protection encompasses five dimensional monitoring from cell to cloud, integrating electrical, thermal, and structural safeguards to minimize thermal runaway and ensure safety for both equipment and personnel.

FAQs
_FAQs

Find comprehensive answers to common questions about our AEM electrolyzers, covering topics such as operational parameters, maintenance requirements, and system configurations. This resource is invaluable for users seeking detailed technical information to optimize performance and ensure the longevity of their hydrogen production systems.

All

(22)
Technical Integration
(37)
What is water specifications for Enapter AEM Electrolysers?
Does switching on and off the electrolyser affect the overall lifetime?
How does the water quality affect the stack degradation and the efficiency of the system?
What is the best possibility to stack Enapter’s electrolysers and other products like the dryer and the water tank module?
Can I mount the devices in an inclined position?
Can I mount the devices in a corrosive environment e.g. near the sea or in very humid environments?
Is there a P&ID (Piping & Instrumentation Diagram) to see the interfaces of the electrolyser and the dryer and how to connect it to other components?
What type of water trap is suitable for the O₂ vent line? Can I use the same type of water trap for the H₂ vent line as well?
What is the H₂ vent/purge outlet for?
What’s the surface, thickness, ion conductivity, water absorption and pressure resistance of the MEA?
What’s the electrode’s material and the exchange current density of the catalyst layer?
What’s the electrical resistance and thermal conductivity of the gas diffusion layer and the current collector and what are their materials, porosity, thickness, geometry, and diameter?
What’s the structure, material, length, width, height, and geometry of the bipolar plates?
What’s the electrical resistance and thermal conductivity, the length, width, height, geometry of the flow channels?
Where can I find the pressure and temperature dependant polarisation curve?
What’s the heat transmission coefficient of the stack?
What’s the overall weight, dimensions (length, width, hight) an geometry of the stack?
How many cells are within one stack?
Are the stack air cooled or liquid cooled?
Which membrane is used for the stack?
Can the Multicore be operated continuously if the input power is changing?
What is included in the Multicore? What’s the difference between the hydrogen output purity?
Do the electrolysers have built-in conductivity sensors? Can they provide measurement values of the absolute water conductivity value?
When does it make sense to not shut down the devices?
What’s the power consumption during the start up and what’s the difference between the internal hydrogen pressure and the outlet pressure?
Is the electrolyte that Enapter uses for its electrolysers environmental-friendly?
Is it possible to use Enapter’s electrolysers for heating/powering my home?
What is the electrolytic cell rated operating temperature in degree Celsius and degree Fahrenheit?
What is the electrolyser cell’s voltage and current range?
How is the pressure controlled for H₂? Is it using a pressure switch and valve?
What is the surface area of the membrane?
What are the differences between the air-cooled and the liquid cooled electrolyser?
Is Nitrogen used during the process?
What are the maintenance and operational costs for an Enapter electrolyser (EL), dryer (DR) and water tank (WT)?
What are the WiFi connection requirements?
Can the electrolyser, dryer, water tank and other devices be recycled?
